name: services/meetings/lecturer_meeting_dates
description: Search for meeting dates of specified meeting conducted by user. Only staff members or administrative consumers can access this method.
brief_description: Search for meeting dates of specified meeting conducted by user.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of meeting_date method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: List of dates for meeting, as described in meeting_date.
errors:
• method_forbidden - access to method denied.

    Possible reasons:

    • staff_only - this method can only be invoked by staff members.
